about: The pre-registration of demo/soil-phys-001: each file's SHA-256, held by test_soil_phys_001.py, committed alone before any real quote, claim or question was asked of the sources. A change is a new freeze.

pass_rules.R1: misquote finds at least 90% of the 30 readable deciding quotes in the right source
pass_rules.R2: claim-check gives all parts from a passage in the right source to at least 60% of the 25 readable lines that hold
pass_rules.R3: the kernel serves a passage from the right source among its top 3 for at least 50% of those 25 lines' questions
pass_rules.R4: claim-check gives all parts to at most 1 of 10 off-topic claims, and the kernel serves anything to at most 2 of 10 off-topic questions

predictions.P1: claim-check gives all parts to at least 1 of revision 1's 3 false claims
predictions.P2: misquote finds 0 of the 5 quotes from sources with no text layer
